# Security reports

Please test against the latest stable Blaze release, or identify the exact
Android APK preview version and build. Android support is experimental.

Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** option under the repository's Security
tab when it is available. Do not post exploit details, credentials, cookies,
tokens, private media links or personal logs in a public issue. If private
reporting is unavailable, open a minimal issue requesting a private reporting
channel without including sensitive details.

Include the affected version/platform, reproduction steps, impact and a
sanitized example. Response times and fixes are not guaranteed. Dependencies
retain their upstream security-reporting processes.
